title: Pressure falls with propofol and remifentanil running, no surgical event
on_screen_label: Composite: Cholec80 video + VitalDB case 59 vitals (real, post-induction), time-shifted to an operative phase

provenance.vitals: real: VitalDB case 59 (time-shifted); fallback keyframes approximate
provenance.drug_log: real TCI tracks from VitalDB case 59 once fetched; drug-03 is a synthetic placeholder

time_base: t_s = seconds from video segment start; negative = before the segment starts.
event_note: Suggested code trigger point: MAP down >= 10 mmHg from its 60-s baseline. Re-derive from real data once fetched.

video.selection_hint: A calm CalotTriangleDissection stretch: Grasper + Hook only for the whole 120 s, no Clipper, Scissors or Irrigator.

vitals_source.real_window_note: Minutes 6-19 from casestart: A-line connected at about minute 6; MAP about 44-52 at minutes 7-9 and 54-65 at minutes 12-17, recovering to 86-105 by minutes 18-19; arterial spikes 220-277 at minutes 16-17 (artifact, exclude). Values read via a page fetcher from 1-min FHIR chunks; re-check.
vitals_source.time_shift: Real samples from time_s 400-520 (about minutes 6.7-8.7), after the arterial line reads physiologic pressure and while propofol and remifentanil TCI are running. Incision is at time_s 1214, so this window is post-induction and before incision. Shown during the demo video; labelled time-shifted.

vitals.fallback_keyframes_label: approximate: shaped from the 1-min summaries in the research notes, not real samples. t_s 0-20 and all HR values are placeholders (no real values known yet).

nibp.note: Cuff at real time_s 401, held through real time_s 487.

drug_log.detail: TCI running (Orchestra PPF20). Effect-site about 3.5 mcg/mL at the start of this window (real time_s 400), about 3.0 by real time_s 520.
TCI running (Orchestra RFTN20). Effect-site about 5.0 ng/mL at real time_s 400, about 4.5 by real time_s 520. Target set to 3.3 ng/mL at real time_s 446 (scenario t 46 s).
drug_log.provenance: real: VitalDB case 59 RFTN20_CE and RFTN20_CT

drug_log.detail: TCI target (PPF20_CT) set to 1 mcg/mL at real time_s 444.

baseline_rule.rule: Fixed BP rule: alarm if arterial MAP < 65 mmHg for >= 60 s (R1) or arterial SBP > 180 mmHg for >= 5 s (R2). Arterial-line numerics only, no context.
baseline_rule.comment: Right to alarm (pressure is low) but gives no cause. 81 s is the fallback-keyframe time. When vitaldb_case59_tracks.csv is present the app replaces this with the time measured on the excerpt.
